text:
tia: Heads up — staging push for redwood/core-service:20260320-rc5 failed provenance check in eu-west-1. deploy-bot blocked the publish, logs show missing buildid annotation.

deploy-bot: publish blocked: ECR_Attestation:missing_build_metadata (request id abc123). See https://ci.internal/inst/12345 :warning:

sam: Ugh. Is this the same missing-buildid flake we hit last week?

jordan: Likely. Artifact was built on builder-3 in job #3402. I can re-run the job with `--embed-buildid` if we want a fresh push.

lina: Before rebuilding, let's not promote rc5. Can we pin the canary to the previous digest instead? Avoid pushing a bad rc to prod.

tia: Agreed — hold all promotion windows for this rollout. Sam, can you coordinate a retag fallback to the previous digest and update the release notes to mark rc5 blocked? :eyes:

sam: On it. Plan: manual retag staging -> previous good digest and create a short release note saying "rc5 blocked: missing provenance metadata". Will also ping release-approvers.

ci-bot: Note: retagging an existing artifact requires consent from `release-approvers`. Use `/release retag --reason "provenance block"` so audit log is attached.

jordan: I'll stand by to run the verification job after sam retags. If verification passes, we schedule a rebuild of rc5 with embedded buildid in tomorrow's change window (03:00 UTC).

lina: Also adding a small snippet to the publish lint we can use going forward to catch this earlier: 
```
if 'buildid' not in manifest.annotations:
  raise PublishHold('missing buildid')
```

 tia: Action items:
 - sam: retag to previous digest + update release notes
 - jordan: run verification job after retag
 - tia: open a quick internal ticket and mark release as blocked
 - ci-bot: require explicit approval on retag

sam: Retag pushed: `docker tag sha256:abcd1234ef redwood/core-service:staging-rollback` and PR created for release-notes. Pinging @release-approvers for approval.

deploy-bot: Approval required. `/release approve requested-by sam` has been queued. :white_check_mark:

lina: Approved from me (thumbs).

jordan: Verification job is green. No regressions on canary.

tia: Thanks team. We'll keep rc5 blocked until we rebuild with embedded buildid and reattempt publish in the scheduled change window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Closing thread — moving notes into the release ticket. :lock:
